criteria.evidence: Section 1 checks in order: corpus/ingestion, retrieval top-k, prompt/context assembly readability, and generation faithfulness. Fixes are also organized by stage, and eval tracks recall@k separately from faithfulness.
criteria.criterion: Trace retrieval, context construction, and generation boundaries.

criteria.evidence: "Find which stage is failing before changing anything." It says to take 20-50 real bad answers, tally failures by stage, and avoid adding a framework or new vector DB until the diagnosis shows it is the limit. It also asks the user for example failures.

It gives a per-stage attribution procedure, "Change one thing at a time and re-run the set", and a separate retrieval vs faithfulness measurement. It does not propose a true isolation experiment, such as feeding the gold passage directly to the model to bypass retrieval, or testing retrieval alone.
criteria.criterion: Use an isolation experiment where appropriate.
